description: LAYER 1: Edge Security Foundation - Fix CORS headers, JWT optional auth paths, and Turnstile fail-closed behavior
steps: 1. In apps/edge/src/middleware/cors.ts: Add 'x-anon-id' to the Access-Control-Allow-Headers string in getCorsHeaders(). The current value is 'Content-Type, Authorization, CF-Turnstile-Response, x-turnstile-token'. Add x-anon-id to this list.
2. In apps/edge/src/middleware/jwt.ts: Add '/api/v1/content' to the PUBLIC_PATHS array (content pages should be accessible without auth).
3. In apps/edge/src/middleware/jwt.ts: Add '/api/v1/conversations/anon' and '/api/v1/edu' to the OPTIONAL_AUTH_PATHS array (these support both anonymous and authenticated usage).

4. In apps/edge/src/index.ts: Fix the Turnstile verification section. Currently when CF_TURNSTILE_SECRET is not configured, it logs a warning and skips verification. Change this to: if env is production (check isProduction variable which is already defined above), REJECT the request with 403 'Turnstile verification not configured' instead of skipping. Only skip in non-production.
acceptance_criteria: index.ts rejects requests with 403 when CF_TURNSTILE_SECRET is missing in production mode
verification: Run: npx tsc --noEmit --project apps/edge/tsconfig.json (or just verify TypeScript syntax is correct)
Verify the files parse without errors
